crossRefs.note: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to reason the cause with you. Why does the way of…
You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and…
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of…
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the…
“You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

translations.web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
translations.bsb: He does not keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted.
translations.kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
translations.asv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted their right.
